description: Installation of a new shopfront comprising of new entrance doors and glazing, 2no new ATM machines to replace the existing ATM machines and replacement of existing stallriser cladding with new black ceramic tiles cladding including retention of the existing entrance canopy with new cladding to match the upper levels at the front elevation; alterations to the side elevation to include the replacement of the existing stallriser cladding with new black ceramic tiles cladding and new replacement cladding to canopy.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials (including colour and finish) specified on the drawings hereby approved. The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - The 'work caf�' hereby approved shall not operate outside the opening hours of the bank and shall not be used independently. The use shall remain ancillary to and functionally always linked with the primary use of the premises as a bank.

To safeguard the amenities of surrounding residential occupiers and to ensure that the caf� use remains ancillary to the primary banking use, as a separate or independent use could give rise to materially different planning considerations that the Local Planning Authority would wish to assess, in accordance with Policies DC1, CC12, CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
